note: Resolves the pilot's open note. The repair agent (consent route exists) and the pilot (no route) were each reading a different clause. Oura's written consent lifts s.4(a)(iii) only; s.4(d) and s.6(g) carry no such route, so under this Agreement alone training on API data is not obtainable, and s.4(d) bars even prompting an AI model with API data outside the MCP Server. "AI Model" is defined to include any "machine learning model", which on its face reaches ordinary statistical ML in a research analysis.
